name: location-07
description: Dot-matrix world map with dashed arcs from headquarters to offices and a city headcount strip below.

files.content:
const hq = { city: "Designali", x: 270, y: 150 } const offices = [ { city: "Central America", x: 225, y: 215, team: 18 }, { city: "South America", x: 340, y: 300, team: 26 }, { city: "Europe", x: 470, y: 125, team: 41 }, { city: "Africa", x: 510, y: 225, team: 12 }, { city: "Middle East", x: 640, y: 190, team: 9 }, { city: "South Asia", x: 705, y: 215, team: 55 }, { city: "East Asia", x: 885, y: 160, team: 22 }, { city: "Oceania", x: 905, y: 330, team: 14 }, ] // Very rough continent ellipses used to mask a dot grid. const land = [ { cx: 230, cy: 140, rx: 110, ry: 70 }, { cx: 340, cy: 290, rx: 50, ry: 80 }, { cx: 520, cy: 130, rx: 70, ry: 45 }, { cx: 530, cy: 250, rx: 60, ry: 80 }, { cx: 720, cy: 150, rx: 170, ry: 70 }, { cx: 900, cy: 320, rx: 50, ry: 30 }, ] function isLand(x: number, y: number) { return land.some( (l) => ((x - l.cx) / l.rx) ** 2 + ((y - l.cy) / l.ry) ** 2 <= 1 ) } const dots: { x: number; y: number }[] = [] for (let x = 10; x < 1000; x += 14) { for (let y = 40; y < 400; y += 14) { if (isLand(x, y)) dots.push({ x, y }) } } function arc(x: number, y: number) { const mx = (hq.x + x) / 2 const my = Math.min(hq.y, y) - Math.abs(x - hq.x) * 0.25 - 20 return `M${hq.x} ${hq.y} Q ${mx} ${my} ${x} ${y}` } export default function Location07() { const total = offices.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.team, 0) + 120 return (

Remote by design

One studio, clients worldwide

Designali is a remote design and development studio with {total}+ projects shipped for clients around the world.

  • {hq.city}

    Remote studio · 120

    • {offices.map((o) => (

  • {o.city}

    {o.team} projects

    • ))}
) }
